system.description:
DISCIPLE MYSTIC STANCE

Prerequisites Devoted or Primal Monastic Path

You embrace the Drunken Stance, a martial technique that emulates the unpredictable movements and deceptive style of a drunken master. In this stance, you appear disoriented but possess remarkable agility and the ability to surprise your opponents.

You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to DB and may also use the Drunken Strike action.

DRUNKEN STRIKE

ATTACK FLOURISH

Action 1 AP

You make a melee attack against your target with a -2-circumstance penalty. If the attack inflicts damage, it is classed as a feint against your target using your total Attack Roll as the Feint DC.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, or two with Stance Mastery; Reactive Stance enters it free at initiative). It lasts until you enter another stance or delete its effect. While in it: +2 circumstance to your DB, and Drunken Strike (added to your abilities) may be used: a melee Strike at −2 circumstance; if it deals damage, your attack total stands as a Feint check against the target's Feint DC, and the Feint's own result applies (Graham's B6-3). The Path is checked when you enter it.
